description_en: Removes tags from cloud desktops. After a tag is removed, if the tag is not added to any cloud desktop, the tag is automatically deleted
description_zh: 为云电脑移除标签。移除标签后，如果该标签没有被添加到任何云电脑上，则标签会被自动删除
kebab_example: aliyun ecd untag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type ALIYUN::GWS::INSTANCE --resource-id ecd-ia2zw38bi6cm70000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UntagResources

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service (EDS)
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to unbind all tags from the resource. This parameter takes effect only when TagKey.N is not specified. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否解绑资源上的所有标签。仅当未设置TagKey.N时，该参数生效。默认为false
parameters.name: all

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the resources, that is, the IDs of the cloud desktops. You can specify 1 to 50 IDs
parameters.help_zh: 资源ID列表，即云电脑ID列表。可包含1\~50个
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The tag keys. You can specify 1 to 20 tag keys
parameters.name: tag_key
